visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Default List Is Shared Between Calls
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each call without a list should start fresh and print ['a'] and then ['b'], but the second call prints ['a', 'b'].
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
def add_item(item, items=[]):
    items.append(item)
    return items


print(add_item("a"))
print(add_item("b"))

solution.code:
def add_item(item, items=None):
    if items is None:
        items = []
    items.append(item)
    return items


print(add_item("a"))
print(add_item("b"))
solution.explanation: items=[] is evaluated once, so every call that omits the argument appends to the same list object. Using None as the default and creating a new list inside the function gives each call its own list.
